facts.business: Goenka Business & Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India, primarily engaged in trading of shares and securities and providing advances to various parties.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Management is very much optimist to continue the same growth in the revenue and Profit of the Company.

key_risks: SEBI order dated 30 June 2026 imposing monetary penalty of ₹1,00,00,000 and restraining company from accessing securities market for 5 years
Revenue recognition policy for trading of shares & securities
Evaluation of financial assets and advances to various parties
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into by the Company with related parties during the financial year were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis, and were reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee. There were no material related party transactions during the year as defined under the Company's policy on materiality of related party transactions.
